name: Beam (formerly Merit Circle, MC)
gap: No qualifying event in window. Insider supply (Seed Contributors, Contributors & Builders) and treasury were on linear vesting inherited from MC; DefiLlama shows one linear schedule starting 2021-10-22 over ~4.5 years (https://defillama.com/protocol/unlocks/beam), DropsTab MC vesting shows Seed 36-month linear and Team & Advisors 48-month linear with 0% at TGE (https://dropstab.com/th/coins/merit-circle/vesting); no single-day cliff >=25% of circulating listed by either. DropsTab BEAM page says BEAM has no contractual vesting schedule and is fully unlocked (https://dropstab.com/hi/coins/beam-2). In Feb 2023 initial contributors voluntarily locked 71.7M MC for four years (https://medium.com/@meritcircle/locking-up-the-majority-share-of-initial-contributor-tokens-for-at-least-4-years-2dffeb6ccea8) - a relock, not an unlock. First insider unlock date left null: MC public launch was the Balancer LBP 2-5 Nov 2021 (https://medium.com/@meritcircle/instructions-for-participating-in-the-balancer-liquidity-bootstrapping-pool-blbp-for-the-merit-b506681deb3f); DefiLlama dates the insider linear stream start 2021-10-22 while DropsTab end dates (Seed Nov 2025, Team Nov 2026) imply a later start, so the first insider transferable day conflicts between sources; it is before the window in every reading. The MC->BEAM 1:100 migration (late Oct 2023, swap not unlock) was not dated from a fetched page. Ad hoc DAO-treasury spends are not scheduled unlocks and were not checked day by day.

name: Creditcoin
gap: No single-day unlock >=25% of circulating found or confirmable in window. The only schedule found is Token Radar (https://tokenradar.ai/tokens/creditcoin/tokenomics), citing the Sept 2023 whitepaper: 600M genesis issuance (investors 200M, Gluwa 300M, Creditcoin Foundation 100M), charted as a 2019 genesis release but also described as Gluwa/Foundation six-year linear vesting with year-level estimated dates and no dates for investor tranches; it says fully unlocked in 2025. That is internally inconsistent and not a primary source, so neither a first-insider-unlock date nor any cliff could be confirmed; first insider unlock is before the window in either reading (2019-2020 genesis/launch). Creditcoin Foundation Q&A (Apr 2023, https://medium.com/creditcoin-foundation/creditcoin-q-a-april-2023-82e8eadb49ad) and docs (https://docs.creditcoin.org/llms-full.txt) cover only swaps (G-CRE/WCTC -> native CTC 1:1, optional merge with 3.0; GATE -> CTC 2:1), which are migrations, not insider unlocks, and give no unlock schedule. Mainnet CTC is block-reward issued (2 CTC/block), a continuous stream. No Tokenomist/DropsTab/CryptoRank vesting page could be fetched.

name: FLock.io
gap: No qualifying event in window. Official docs (https://docs.flock.io/flock-tokenomics/token-allocations): investors and Team & Advisors both have a 1-year cliff then 2 years linear; community emissions minted over 60 months with 1% monthly decay (a stream). TGE 2024-12-30 per tokenomics.com (https://app.tokenomics.com/tokenomics/flock/unlocks), so the insider cliff cannot end before ~2025-12-30, after the window end 2025-11-16; exact first insider unlock day and whether it is a lump or the start of monthly vesting could not be confirmed (Tokenomist past-event table is paywalled: https://tokenomist.ai/flock-2/unlock-events; tokenomics.com shows only events from Apr 2026, all monthly ~4-7% of mcap). firstInsiderUnlock.date 2025-12-30 is derived (TGE + 12-month cliff), not confirmed by a project statement; inWindow false either way. TGE itself released only community/ecosystem tokens (launch, no prior circulating) and is not a B event. tokenomics.com has internal inconsistencies (0% float at TGE vs Community 10.6% / Ecosystem 40% at TGE). Binance perp listed 2025-09 per input; symbol assumed FLOCKUSDT, not verified.

name: Kaspa
gap: No insider unlocks exist: Kaspa was a fair-launch proof-of-work coin (mainnet November 2021) with no premine, no pre-sale and no team or VC allocation; supply enters only through mining emissions (a continuous stream with smooth monthly 'chromatic' reduction), so no single-day unlock can reach 25% of circulating. Sources: kaspa.org 'No premine. No hidden allocation. Fair launch.' (https://kaspa.org/?p=45929, primary); KuCoin Learn 'fair launch with no pre-sale, no pre-mine, and no token allocations to the team or venture capitalists', launched November 2021 (https://www.kucoin.com/knowledge-base/Concepts/what-is-kaspa-kas, aggregator). firstInsiderUnlock set to null because there is no insider group. Note: input lists binancePerpSince 2023-11, but KAS was not checked for a Binance USDT-M perp listing; symbol KASUSDT unverified.

name: Plume Network
gap: No qualifying event in window (2025-01-01 to 2025-11-16). tokenomics.com (https://app.tokenomics.com/tokenomics/plume-network/unlocks): TGE 2025-01-21; Private Investors 21% and Core Contributors 20% both 0% at TGE, 12-month cliff with 33% unlock, then 24-month linear; Community & Ecosystem 39% (29.5% at TGE, 36m linear), Airdrop 7% (100% TGE), Foundation 13% (11.5% at TGE, 36m linear) - all non-insider flows are monthly streams. First insider unlock is therefore the 12-month cliff ~2026-01-21 (TGE + 12 months), after the window. Tokenomist weekly digest for Jan 19-25 2026 (https://tokenomist.ai/insights/weekly-unlock-digest-jan-19-25-2026) confirms a January 2026 PLUME insider unlock (investors + core contributors, ~39.75% of circulating, ~$24M) but its day is missing, so the exact day comes from the tokenomics.com TGE date plus cliff, not a project statement.

name: Solayer (LAYER)
gap: No qualifying event in window (2025-02-01 to 2025-11-16). Official docs (https://docs.solayer.org/resources/tokenomics.md): Core Contributors 17.11% '1-year cliff, 3 years linear'; Investors 16.66% 1-year cliff then 2 years linear; Community & Ecosystem 51.23% and Foundation 15% vest every 3 months over 4 years; initial circulating 220M (22%). TGE 2025-02-10 per tokenomics.com (https://app.tokenomics.com/tokenomics/solayer/unlocks); Genesis Drop claims started 2025-02-11 (KuCoin news). Insider cliffs therefore end ~Feb 2026, after the window; firstInsiderUnlock.date 2026-02-10 is derived (tokenomics.com TGE + 12-month cliff), not confirmed by a project statement; could be Feb 11 (Genesis Drop start); inWindow false either way. Largest in-window event found: quarterly Foundation + Community & Ecosystem tranche on 2025-05-11 = 12.87% of circulating per Tokenomist digest (https://tokenomist.ai/research/weekly-unlocks-digest-week-1-may-2025), below 25%; later quarterly tranches (Aug/Nov 2025) are smaller relative to a larger float (my schedule estimate ~26.4M LAYER each). Binance perp: input says none; Bybit symbol (LAYERUSDT) not verified.

name: Zebec Network (ZBCN, formerly ZBC)
gap: No qualifying event in window (2024-04-01 to 2025-11-16). ZBC TGE 2022-03-17 per tokenomics.com (https://app.tokenomics.com/tokenomics/zebec-network): Contributors 20%, Private 11%, Seed 9% each 6-month cliff then 36-month linear; Community & Rewards 50% 48-month linear; Market Making 4% 36-month linear - all streams, no large cliffs. First insider unlock date is derived (TGE + 6-month cliff), not confirmed by a project statement; tokenomics.com has internal inconsistencies (17% vs 2.8% at TGE; all pools shown finished although a 48-month schedule from 2022 runs into 2026). The ZBC->ZBCN 1:10 migration (ZBC trading halted Apr 8, ZBCN trading and swap from Apr 10 to May 10, 2024; ZIP-5 https://medium.com/zebec-protocol/zip-5-proposal-to-migrate-zbc-to-zbcn-380b6cf1072e; docs say no new supply minted, https://docs.zebec.io/zebec-network-archive/zebec-network-archive/zbcn-tokemonics) is a redenomination swap, not an unlock, so not listed. Largest in-window release found: 2.12B ZBCN on 2025-09-16 (CoinChapter, https://coinchapter.com/?p=134533) with ~87.9B circulating after, i.e. ~2.5% - far below 25%. Zebec bought back ~300M ZBC from investors in 2023 (Zebec Medium 2024 update).
